purpose: Prove an ordinary goal can derive a terminal effect, synthesize a verified multi-capability graph, wire producer output into consumer input through declared effect-result metadata, execute the graph, and independently verify the resulting artifact without mission-authored target effects, semantic proposals, capability proposal, controller actions, or valueflow links.
goal: Assess the knowledge consistency of the observation available from https://httpbin.org/get?claim=alpha.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime')
mission=json.loads((root/'missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_AUTO_MULTI_CAPABILITY_PROPOSAL_001.json').read_text())
step=mission['steps'][0]
for forbidden in ('required_target_effects','semantic_goal_proposals','capability_problem_proposal','controller_actions'):
    assert forbidden not in step, forbidden
state=json.loads((root/'state/ASTRA-RUNTIME-AUTO-MULTI-CAPABILITY-PROPOSAL-001.json').read_text())
result=state['history'][0]['result']
semantic=result['semantic_goal_contract']
generation=result['proposal_generation']
assert semantic['status']=='QUORUM_VERIFIED', semantic
assert semantic['target_effects']==['knowledge.assessment.available'], semantic
assert set(semantic['generated_authorities'])=={'registry-effect-lexical-v1','compiler-score-v1'}, semantic
assert generation['generator']=='multi-verified-capability-v1', generation
assert generation['capability_plan']==['knowledge.json.fetch.external','knowledge.consistency.assess'], generation
bindings=generation['bindings']['auto-knowledge-consistency-assess']['evidence_paths']
assert bindings['type']=='effect_result', bindings
assert bindings['effect']=='knowledge.observation.available', bindings
assert bindings['field']=='output_path', bindings
assessment=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/auto_proposal/a2dea4426d0a1217_knowledge-consistency-assess_output-path.json').read_text())
assert assessment['schema']=='PROJECT_BRAIN_KNOWLEDGE_ASSESSMENT_V1', assessment
assert assessment['status']=='INSUFFICIENT', assessment
assert assessment['evidence_count']==1, assessment
assert assessment['fresh_evidence_count']==1, assessment
assert assessment['invalid']==[], assessment
print('AUTO_MULTI_CAPABILITY_PROPOSAL_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED')
PY
